S005.quote:
Abstract: In this work, we model a 5G downlink channel using millimeter-wave (mmWave) and
massive Multiple-Input Multiple-Output (mMIMO) technologies, considering the following local-
ization parameters: Time of Arrival (TOA), Two-Dimensional Angle of Departure (2D-AoD), and
Two-Dimensional Angle of Arrival (2D-AoA), both encompassing azimuth and elevation. Our
research focuses on the precise estimation of these parameters within a three-dimensional (3D) envi-
ronment, which is crucial in Industry 4.0 applications such as smart warehousing. In such scenarios,
determining the device localization is paramount, as products must be handled with high precision.
To achieve these precise estimations, we employ an adaptive approach built upon the Distributed
Compressed Sensing—Subspace Orthogonal Matching Pursuit (DCS-SOMP) algorithm. We obtain
better estimations using an adaptive approach that dynamically adapts the sensing matrix during
each iteration, effectively constraining the search space. The results demonstrate that our approach
outperforms the traditional method in terms of accuracy, speed to convergence, and memory use.

S006.quote: Keywords: 5G; compressed sensing; DCS-SOMP; parameter estimation

S013.quote:
Millimeter-wave (mmWave) and massive Multiple-Input Multiple-Output (mMIMO)
technologies are some of the enablers for the future deployment of 5G and beyond 5G
networks, constituting essential assets for realizing the full potential of disruptive 5G ap-
plications, especially those involving device localization, such as Industry 4.0, Unmanned
Aerial Vehicles (UAVs), and Vehicle to Everything (V2X) communications. These technolo-
gies signiﬁcantly enhance the accuracy of localization parameter estimation, such as the
Time of Arrival (ToA), Angle of Departure (AoD), and Angle of Arrival (AoA) of signals.

S022.quote:
Localization algorithms use localization parameters that can be estimated from the
received signal using techniques such as Multiple Signal Classiﬁcation (MUSIC) [1] and
Compressed Sensing (CS) [2]. MUSIC-based methods analyze the cross-correlations among
the received signals to identify the angles associated with their peaks in the power spec-
trum [3]. On the other hand, methods based on CS exploit the sparsity of signals, i.e., instead
of acquiring the complete signal, CS enables accurate signal reconstruction using a few
important components while the rest are negligible [2]. Among the CS-based methods, we
highlight Distributed Compressed Sensing—Subspace Orthogonal Matching Pursuit (DCS-
SOMP). DCS-SOMP combines the concept of CS with the Orthogonal Matching Pursuit
(OMP) algorithm to handle sparse signals in a distributed environment or in systems with
multiple antennas (e.g., mMIMO systems) [4].

S023.quote: This article is an open access article

S028.quote:
In this work, we focus on the DCS-SOMP method, since it aligns more effectively
with the sparse nature of mmWave signals. In [5,6], the DCS-SOMP method is applied
to parameter estimation in a two-dimensional (2D) environment, providing only a coarse
estimation of parameters which is followed by a reﬁnement step using the Space-alternating
Generalized Expectation-maximization (SAGE) method [7].

S031.quote:
Our proposal has two novelties: ﬁrst, our approach entails the dynamic adaptation
of the sensing matrix, obtaining rapid and accurate parameter estimation through the
DCS-SOMP method and second, we perform all parameter estimation within a three-
dimensional (3D) environment. Our proposal relies on accurate channel modeling using
two-dimensional AoD and AoA parameters coupled with Antennas’s Uniform Circular
Arrays (UCA).

S032.quote:
The remainder of this article is organized as follows: in Section 2, a literature review
is presented. Section 3 outlines the system model, focusing on the channel and received
signal modeling. Section 4 elaborates on constructing the sensing matrix and applying the
DCS-SOMP method, including the proposed modiﬁcation for adaptive search in the sensing
matrix. In Section 5, simulation results are presented and discussed. Finally, Section 6
concludes the article.

S034.quote:
Localization algorithms typically consist of two fundamental steps. First, the esti-
mation of localization parameters extracted from the received signal. Second, using the
acquired parameters from the ﬁrst step, a localization method is employed to determine
the position of the mobile station (MS) [5,8,9]. Regarding the ﬁrst step, we highlight several
aspects of the literature.

S035.quote:
In [10], the authors estimate AoA and AoD using Sparse Bayes Tensor (SBT) from
channel modeling using MIMO and mmWave. However, due to the use of a linear array
of antennas, the proposed approach can only determine the azimuth of AoA and AoD
and does not enable ToA estimation. In [8], the authors conduct indoor localization using
channel modeling and ray tracing. They use two Uniform Linear Arrays (ULA), one
perpendicular to the other, to extract the elevation angle. However, the method does not
estimate AoD, thus preventing the use of algorithms dependent on this parameter.

S036.quote:
In [5], the authors propose a comprehensive localization algorithm using MIMO,
mmWave, and ULA. They employ the DCS-SOMP method for parameter estimation.
Due to the linear antenna array, the method applies to a 2D environment. Additionally,
the DCS-SOMP method provides only a coarse parameter estimate, demanding further
ﬁne-tuning using the SAGE method. In [11], the authors propose a 2D-AoA and 2D-AoD
estimation using the MUSIC algorithm. The method utilizes a channel model with a
rectangular Uniform Rectangular Array (URA). However, their proposal does not estimate
ToA and only allows coarse angle estimation. Similarly to [5], the proposal in [11] requires
ﬁne-tuning techniques to provide accurate parameter estimations. In [12], the authors
propose a technique named spatial spectrum fusion estimation and localization (SSFEAL)
for performing 2D-AoA estimation using UCA in a MIMO mmWave channel.

S037.quote:
In this work, we go beyond the related studies by proposing a joint estimation method
of ToA, 2D-AoD, and 2D-AoA, enabling the use of these parameters in 3D localization
algorithms in multipath environments. Furthermore, our proposed method accurately
estimates the parameters without additional ﬁne-tuning techniques. We employ a MIMO
mmWave channel model with UCA to determine 2D-AoD and 2D-AoA, consistent with
the works in [12,13]. Table 1 compares our proposal with others discussed in this section.

S038.quote:
Table 1 demonstrates aspects of some related works and our proposal. Column 2
indicates the method used for parameter estimation. Column 3 displays the antenna array,
while columns 4 to 6 specify whether the method estimates ToA, 2D-AoD, and 2D-AoA
parameters, respectively. Our proposal presents the advantage of estimating all considered
localization parameters (ToA, 2D-AoD, and 2D-AoA), while other methods estimate only
some of them, or consider only two-dimensional (2D) environments. Additionally, our
proposal utilizes the DCS-SOMP itself to achieve high accuracy, while other methods rely
on extra algorithms for a reﬁnement step. Although estimating ﬁve parameters increases
the number of elements in the sensing matrix, our adaptive approach reduces execution
time and yields more accurate results.

S051.quote:
As outlined in the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) guidelines released in
the TR 38.901 V17.0.0 [14], we analyze a MIMO system with Nt transmitter antennas at
the base station (BS) and Nr receiver antennas at the MS. This system operates at carrier
frequency fc and with bandwidth B. Similarly to [5], we consider the BS to send G signals
to the receiver, where the g-th signal is composed of Mt symbols. Furthermore, we consider
an indoor environment where there are L paths for the signals being transmitted from a
single BS to the MS, such paths can be classiﬁed as Line of Sight (LoS) and single-bounce
Non-Line of Sight (NLoS) paths. Multiple-bounce paths are not taken into account due
to their limited reception strength at mmWave frequencies [15]. Additionally, we assume
perfect clock synchronization, as in [16], enabling accurate ToA estimation.

moves products from the conveyor belt to the shelves. In such a scenario, the localization
and tracking of the forklift can be achieved using geometry-based methods, which rely on
accurate estimation of localization parameters [5,17].

S286.quote:
In this work, we addressed the problem of low performance presented by traditional
DCS-SOMP approaches, which present convergence and precision to estimate parameters
only at the cost of low performance. To achieve this, we proposed an adaptive DCS-SOMP
method that dynamically calculates the sensing matrix, presenting high performance in
precisely estimating localization parameters while keeping the algorithm simple and with
fast convergence.

S287.quote:
This modiﬁcation transformed the DCS-SOMP method from solely a coarse estimator
to a singular tool for precise parameter estimation. Even in a 3D environment with ﬁve
parameters to be estimated and multiple paths to be detected, the adaptive DCS-SOMP
method exhibited substantial improvements in both accuracy and speed compared to
the DCS-SOMP approach. Further enhancements to the adaptive DCS-SOMP could be
explored, such as reﬁning the way the residue was updated, potentially enabling improved
separation of paths. Furthermore, we plan to explore alternative antenna arrays, including
2D conﬁgurations, to enhance beam-forming capabilities in mmWave scenarios within 5G
and B5G networks.

S300.quote: This book introduces the fundamental principles of antenna theory and explains how to apply them to the analysis, design, and measurements of antennas. Due to the variety of methods of analysis and design, and the different antenna structures available, the applications covered in this book are made to some of the most basic and practical antenna configurations. Among these antenna configurations are linear dipoles; loops; arrays; broadband antennas; aperture antennas; horns; microstrip antennas; and reflector antennas. The text contains sufficient mathematical detail to enable undergraduate and beginning graduate students in electrical engineering and physics to follow the flow of analysis and design. Readers should have a basic knowledge of undergraduate electromagnetic theory, including Maxwells equations and the wave equation, introductory physics, and differential and integral calculus.

nodes.title: 问题定义：现有 2D 及粗略估计方法的局限性
系统模型：基于 UCA 的 3D MIMO-mmWave 信道
感知矩阵构建：克罗内克积与候选网格
核心机制：动态自适应搜索空间缩减
估计算法：改进的 DCS-SOMP 迭代流程
复杂度分析：内存占用与执行时间的权衡
仿真结果：收敛性与精度验证
局限性与未来工作范围

concept-da75bade55426c9c.title: 分布式压缩感知子空间正交匹配追踪
concept-da75bade55426c9c.lead: 一种结合压缩感知与正交匹配追踪的算法，用于处理稀疏信号。
concept-da75bade55426c9c.text: DCS-SOMP 利用信号的稀疏性，在分布式环境或多天线系统（如 mMIMO）中，通过迭代选择与残差相关性最高的原子来重构信号。在传统应用中，它常作为粗略估计阶段。
concept-da75bade55426c9c.why: 理解该算法是区分本文提出的“自适应”改进与传统方法的关键，也是解释为何传统方法需要 SAGE 微调的基础。

concept-6d720f284f1322f7.title: 三维定位参数
concept-6d720f284f1322f7.lead: 描述信号在三维空间传播特性的五个关键物理量。
concept-6d720f284f1322f7.text: 包括到达时间（ToA）、二维出发角（方位角 φaz 和仰角 φel）以及二维到达角（方位角 θaz 和仰角 θel）。完整估计这些参数是实现高精度三维定位的前提。
concept-6d720f284f1322f7.why: 这是本文试图一次性解决的核心估计目标，区别于仅估计部分参数或仅限 2D 的现有工作。

concept-b8e27466863cc7bc.title: 均匀圆形阵列
concept-b8e27466863cc7bc.lead: 一种天线排列几何结构，天线单元均匀分布在圆周上。
concept-b8e27466863cc7bc.text: 相比于线性阵列（ULA），UCA 能够提供全向覆盖，并且其几何对称性使得系统能够区分信号的方位角和仰角，从而支持三维空间的角度估计。其半径 r 通常与天线数量和波长有关。
concept-b8e27466863cc7bc.why: 这是本文系统模型区别于仅能做 2D 估计的现有工作的核心硬件假设，直接决定了能否提取仰角信息。

concept-8f5fc25dca95aa0c.title: 视距与非视距路径
concept-8f5fc25dca95aa0c.lead: 无线信号从发射端到接收端的两种主要传播机制。
concept-8f5fc25dca95aa0c.text: LoS (Line of Sight) 指直射路径；NLoS (Non-Line of Sight) 指经过一次反射的路径。在毫米波频段，多次反射路径能量衰减极大，因此模型通常只考虑 LoS 和单 bounce NLoS 路径。
concept-8f5fc25dca95aa0c.why: 理解路径构成有助于明白信道矩阵 H[n] 中求和项 L 的物理意义，以及为何忽略多 bounce 路径。

concept-e878ee9e2574ae50.title: 克罗内克积
concept-e878ee9e2574ae50.lead: 一种将两个任意大小的矩阵组合成一个更大的分块矩阵的运算。
concept-e878ee9e2574ae50.text: 在 MIMO 信道建模中，克罗内克积常用于将发射端和接收端的阵列响应特性结合起来，构建整体的信道观测矩阵或感知矩阵。
concept-e878ee9e2574ae50.why: 这是构建高维感知矩阵 ω(0) 的核心数学工具，直接决定了矩阵的维度爆炸问题。

concept-3d0d3c80a8d385c3.title: 候选网格
concept-3d0d3c80a8d385c3.lead: 在压缩感知中预先定义的一组离散参数值，用于近似连续参数空间。
concept-3d0d3c80a8d385c3.text: 网格的密度（由 qaz 和 qel 决定）直接影响估计的分辨率和精度。网格越密，精度越高，但计算和存储开销也越大。
concept-3d0d3c80a8d385c3.why: 理解候选网格的概念是理解为何需要“自适应”方法来动态调整搜索空间的关键。

concept-9e5a7281c2672eac.title: 搜索空间缩减 (Search Space Reduction)
concept-9e5a7281c2672eac.lead: 一种通过迭代缩小参数搜索范围来降低计算复杂度的策略。
concept-9e5a7281c2672eac.text: 在本文语境下，指不一次性遍历所有可能的角度组合，而是根据前一轮的估计结果，仅在最有可能包含真实值的局部小范围内进行精细搜索。
concept-9e5a7281c2672eac.why: 这是自适应 DCS-SOMP 能够在使用少量候选点（小 qaz/qel）的情况下仍能达到高精度的关键机制。

concept-657ee53e5fedc757.title: 动态区间 (Dynamic Interval)
concept-657ee53e5fedc757.lead: 随迭代过程不断变化的角度搜索范围。
concept-657ee53e5fedc757.text: 该区间的起始和结束角度（如 ˘φaz_start, ˘φaz_end）完全取决于上一轮迭代选出的最佳索引位置，而非固定不变。
concept-657ee53e5fedc757.why: 理解该区间的动态生成规则是掌握自适应算法如何避免陷入局部最优并保持收敛性的基础。

concept-f4e09c0d4fdd4d28.title: 残差更新 (Residual Update)
concept-f4e09c0d4fdd4d28.lead: 贪婪算法中用于分离多径信号的关键步骤。
concept-f4e09c0d4fdd4d28.text: 在估计出当前最强路径的参数后，从接收信号中减去该路径的重构信号，剩余的信号即为残差，用于后续路径的估计。
concept-f4e09c0d4fdd4d28.why: 这是 SOMP 类算法能够逐个识别多条路径的基础，其准确性直接影响后续路径的估计效果。

concept-a71342c0720d1a01.title: 克罗内克积 (Kronecker Product)
concept-a71342c0720d1a01.lead: 用于构建联合发射和接收阵列响应矩阵的数学运算。
concept-a71342c0720d1a01.text: 在 2D-AoD 和 2D-AoA 估计中，通过将方位和仰角的导向矢量进行克罗内克积，构建高维的感知矩阵列。
concept-a71342c0720d1a01.why: 该运算使得算法能够同时处理多维角度参数，但也导致了感知矩阵维度的爆炸式增长，是引入自适应机制的主要动因。

concept-f1f220e14f08e9e1.title: 计算复杂度 (Computational Complexity)
concept-f1f220e14f08e9e1.lead: 衡量算法所需计算资源随输入规模增长的速率。
concept-f1f220e14f08e9e1.text: 在此文中，主要关注浮点运算次数（Mathematical Operations）和内存元素数量。复杂度越低，算法在实时系统中的可行性越高。
concept-f1f220e14f08e9e1.why: 这是评估自适应机制是否成功的核心指标，直接反映了算法从“不可用”到“实用”的转变。

concept-5bc49b3d2e23a756.title: 感知矩阵规模 (Sensing Matrix Size)
concept-5bc49b3d2e23a756.lead: 存储感知矩阵 ω 所需的内存元素总数。
concept-5bc49b3d2e23a756.text: 计算公式涉及天线数、符号数及角度候选数的组合。矩阵规模过大是导致标准方法在样本数增加时失效的主要原因。
concept-5bc49b3d2e23a756.why: 理解矩阵规模的构成有助于明白为何减少 qaz/qel 能对内存产生指数级的优化效果。

concept-e69252ea5448c7b8.title: 均方根误差 (RMSE)
concept-e69252ea5448c7b8.lead: 评估估计值与真实值偏差的关键指标。
concept-e69252ea5448c7b8.text: RMSE 是预测值与观测值之间差异的平方平均数的平方根。在本研究中，用于量化 AoD、AoA 和 ToA 估计的准确性，公式为 ε = sqrt(1/Q * Σ|pi - p̂i|^2)。
concept-e69252ea5448c7b8.why: 理解 RMSE 有助于直观判断自适应方法为何被认为‘更精确’，因为其在所有参数上均实现了更低的误差值。

concept-fdd252584dfbacd1.title: 计算复杂度
concept-fdd252584dfbacd1.lead: 衡量算法效率的理论指标，通常涉及运算次数或时间复杂度。
concept-fdd252584dfbacd1.text: 文中通过统计执行时间（秒）和数学运算总次数来衡量复杂度。自适应方法通过将复杂度从 O(LNt(qc)^2) 降低到 O(LNtqcqit)，显著减少了资源消耗。
concept-fdd252584dfbacd1.why: 解释为何自适应方法能在保持精度的同时实现更快的运行速度，是评估其实用性的核心依据。

concept-ed64fa1188df2910.title: 时钟同步
concept-ed64fa1188df2910.lead: 确保发射端与接收端时间基准一致的技术要求。
concept-ed64fa1188df2910.text: 在 ToA 估计中，发送端和接收端的时钟必须严格同步，否则时间差会被误认为是传播延迟。本文假设‘完美同步’，即无时钟偏差，这简化了模型但限制了实际适用性。
concept-ed64fa1188df2910.why: 这是理解 ToA 估计精度前提的关键，若同步不完美，文中报告的低 RMSE 可能无法在现实中复现。

concept-1731e09db4f2e58c.title: 单反射非视距路径
concept-1731e09db4f2e58c.lead: 信号经一次反射后到达接收端的路径类型。
concept-1731e09db4f2e58c.text: 在室内毫米波环境中，信号可能被墙壁或物体反射一次到达接收机。模型忽略了经过多次反射的路径，因为其能量衰减严重，对总信号贡献较小。
concept-1731e09db4f2e58c.why: 该假设决定了信道模型的复杂度，也是未来需要扩展以适应更复杂环境的关键点。
